messages:
mike: PR #22410 — need quick sync. mac-e2e stuck, trying to land before nightly blackout at 00:00 UTC. Options: wait for CI, split into smaller PRs, or request a short rebase slot. Any preferences?

devops-jen: I see the mac queue is backed up. One rerun might clear it but queue ETA ~2h. If the risky bits can be isolated, splitting is fastest.

sam: The change touches schema + telemetry so splitting is annoying. We can try a focused follow-up for telemetry, but schema must land together.

mike: ok — plan: I'll rebase onto latest main and kick a rerun. If it still flakes, i'll open a minimal PR with just the non-schema fix. pinging @nora for a short slot if rerun fails.

devops-jen: If you rebase and push, I can bump one rerun to the front, no promises. Also, include a short test matrix summary in the PR comment so release team can assess risk. Use label `urgent-merge` if you want me to nudge.

mike: doing rebase now: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push -f`. Will update the PR link once pushed.

ci-bot: mac-e2e queue length: 12. avg runtime: 18m. recent flake rate: 6%.

mike: pushed — https://github.com/redwood/pr/22410 — starting rerun. if this fails, i'll open a tiny follow-up with just the config change and request slot.

nora: ack. i'll hold one short rebase slot if rerun fails, but we need a one-paragraph risk blurb and failing test links. prefer to avoid landing during blackout unless it's urgent.

mike: understood — will post tests + links in 15m. thanks all :thumbsup:
